purpose: Prospectively fixed one-factor matched-budget training of the output-scale operator; engineering development diagnostic only.

runtime.estimated_whole_job_minutes: 3-5; prior 2400-update comparison 221.62 seconds with twice as many evaluation forwards

claims_and_guards: Latest user approval authorizes implementation and this bounded matched comparison. Do not expand budget, tune loss, operator constant or capacity.
Original immutable feature cache, 8/4 complete episode split, three seeds, 200x16 original shared draws and train-only input statistics; no refit or new encoding.
No PI0.5 backbone fine-tuning, mixed-head/guidewire interface change, collector changes, project-data reads, oracle inputs or policy rollout.
Fit both fresh variants for exactly200 updates, save final200 only in a new strict envelope; never convert old checkpoints or select a best validation checkpoint.

Primary observed-action comparison: every seed objective must decrease and equal-seed means of aggregate and each h1/h2/h3 visual and normalized-state MAE must not increase. Report failed guards, absolute/relative deltas and paired population SD; no significance claim.

Report RMSE, separate visual/state SmoothL1 components, per-episode metrics, per-horizon/per-view detail and effective/raw vector RMS. Vector RMS control is structural, not evidence of quality or all coordinates being unsaturated.
Secondary normalized-zero-action remains separate. Winning the normalized reference does not automatically win the original saved raw baseline; report both without automatic promotion.
Clean-only evaluation step0/final200 on500 windows in33 original episode-homogeneous batches per model/phase. No noise interventions rerun and no robustness claim.
Reference normalized model must replay all1200 training records,396 clean evaluation prediction/score groups,6 final model states, per-episode/micro/base-macro metrics and activation summaries.
Validation has already been used in development. This is not an independent test, family generalization, policy benefit, architectural innovation, formal-training-readiness or real-system result.
Any failure preserves partial outputs. Inspect status/failure/started process before retry consideration; no automatic retry/resume. Large transfers over100MB remain user-owned.
